notes: «وبهذا الإسناد عن محمد بن عثمان» opens the report: prev1 (91) has no written chain, so the names are taken from prev2 (90) up to the text's own «محمد بن عثمان»; the «الكاتب» titles are left out.
Needs ruling: «فقلت لأبي- أو لأخي -: أي شي‏ء قال؟» is a first-person narrator with an unnamed speaker; the dash-gloss «أو لأخي» is an editor's alternative and is not used.
«ذكر أن النبي» is passive with no named transmitter, so Jabir ibn Samura is the last named link.
